perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Suros Synergy
perks.desc: Reloading grants this weapon bonus handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BurstDamage PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for burst DPS against Banes, Elites, Champions or Minibosses, or shorter boss DPS windows in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Monody-44 is a high-impact fusion rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic being a big total damage outlier, and very underrated. The frame intrinsic provides ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when stationary or moving less than 2.8m/s (crouch walking) and ADS as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are good by comparison with its peer - hopefully when the website's back https://d2foundry.gg/w/3201200906 will show how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. Use the barrel perk to boost Handling, and the battery perk to improve Charge Time or boost battery size. There aren't any trait perks that help with reloading or refilling the battery in a boss fight, so you're best option in the first trait perk column is Attrition Orbs, which will at least drop a power orb after you've emptied your battery to keep ammo mods charged. In the second column, Controlled Burst reduces charge time to ×0.9 and boosts damage by ×1.2 for 2s (2.5s when enhanced) after landing all the bolts in a burst, or a kill. Situationally, you might also consider Surrounded to boost damage by up to to ×1.4 (×1.47 enhanced) while within 15m of 3+ enemies. The Suros Synergy origin trait is useful, granting +30 Handling and ×1.2 flinch resistance for 6s after reloading. If you're interested, a monody is an ode sung by one voice (as in a Greek tragedy) or an elegy or dirge performed by one person. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with an enhanced Charge Time mod or your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvP PvP-KillChain PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for kill-chaining in 6s. Monody-44 is, at time of writing, a solid A-Tier or high-end B-Tier special option, which Lego describes as having "an accuracy cone that ignores the law of physics" and is demonstrated in Lego's video. The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows a base charge time for high-impact fusions of 967ms - the v9.5.0 patch nerfed the charge time slightly from .960s - and a 3-bolt kill, out of 5 bolts fired. High Impacts reward a play slower and methodical approach from the huge frame intrinsic of an ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when stationary or moving slowly (<2.8m/s which is walking speed when crouched). That's the equivalent of the average Under Pressure cone size buff and the original unnerfed Firmly Planted accuracy cone growth buff rolled into one. The stats aren't great compared to the high-impact king Glacioclasm, but as the only one that offers tiered rolls, you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to fill all of the stat gaps at Tiers 4 and 5. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/3201200906 for yourself. Range with the barrel and battery perks is key to controlling the recoil - ideally without any stat penalties. In the first trait perk column for kill-chaining, Discord grants a +30 Aerial Effectiveness, ×0.75 ADS animation modifier and a ×0.75 accuracy cone size for 7s (8s when enhanced) after swapping within 5s of another weapon kill, but crucially any kills while active refund a shot from thin air so you'll not run out of ammo. In the second column Closing Time provides a linearly scaling buff from half full battery to empty up to +10 Range, +25 Handling, ×0.95 accuracy cone size and a ×0.90 handling animation scalar at max effect. The Suros Synergy origin trait is useful for PvP - on finishing a reload, you'll gain +40 Handling and ×0.8 flinch for 6s. Recommended MW: Charge Time, with a Range enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.
